links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of chatbot responses versus US adult health literacy benchmark
links.effect: ChatGPT-5 responses at middle school level, aligned with US adult health literacy benchmark; Claude 4.5 Sonnet responses at high school level, above the benchmark.
links.quote: ChatGPT-5 produced responses at the middle school level, better aligned with the US adult health literacy benchmark, while Claude 4.5 Sonnet generated responses at the high school level.

links.outcome: Consistency of chatbot responses across repeated identical prompts
links.effect: Both models demonstrated identical internal consistency of 90%; accuracy improved on re-prompting after 24 hours.
links.quote: Both models demonstrated an identical internal consistency at 90%.
